items.title: Binding of Isaac developer removes AI music from Repentance Plus
items.excerpt: AI-generated tracks in a GTA 6-themed run of The Binding of Isaac: Repentance+ were pulled after a review-bombing backlash; creator Edmund McMillen says he 'had no idea' AI music had been used. (Same story may also surface in the games section.)

items.title: Muse's Matt Bellamy Wants an AI Guitar
items.excerpt: Speaking with Guitar.com, Muse's Matt Bellamy described wanting an AI-integrated guitar he can talk to, telling it what he wants his tone to sound like rather than dialling it in by hand.

items.title: 듀스, 31년 만에 정규 4집 발매…이현도·AI 김성재가 그린 '우리'의 내일
items.excerpt: 힙합 듀오 듀스가 31년 만에 정규 4집 'DEUX 4TH'를 냈다. 이현도가 총괄 프로듀싱하고, 인공지능(AI) 기술로 고(故) 김성재의 목소리를 되살려 '완전체' 신곡을 채웠다.

items.title: '대세' 장한별, 화제의 AI 곡 '꿈꾸던 어른이 되었나요?' 라이브 커버 공개
items.excerpt: 가수 장한별이 AI 가상 보컬 머무르의 멜론 1위곡 '꿈꾸던 어른이 되었나요?'를 라이브로 커버해 사흘 만에 47만 뷰, 유튜브 하이프 10위에 올랐다. 인간 가수가 AI 히트곡을 재해석한 사례로 반응이 엇갈린다.

items.title: Travis Tritt Slams 'Obviously Fake' AI Video That Appeared to Show Him Criticizing Taylor Swift at the CMAs
items.excerpt: A viral clip appearing to show Travis Tritt bashing the CMA Awards' focus on Taylor Swift was AI-generated, the country singer says, telling fans on X to 'disregard them completely'.

items.title: AI Copyright Changes Could Cost MPs Votes in 21 Key Electorates, New Poll Finds
items.excerpt: Polling of 1,464 voters across 21 Australian federal electorates, released by the new 'Not AI's to Take' creative-industry campaign, found widespread opposition to unpaid AI training on creative work.

items.title: Who Is NAVA? The Virtual Persian Singer Behind Charlotte de Witte's Azadi
items.excerpt: NAVA, an AI-generated virtual Persian singer created by British-Iranian digital artist Farbod Mehr, reached the techno mainstream via Charlotte de Witte's 'Azadi', voicing women whose right to sing publicly is restricted.

items.title: Why I Switched to AI Music for My YouTube Videos
items.excerpt: A longtime YouTuber repeatedly hit by copyright claims on licensed library music switched to Suno-generated soundtracks and argues they now sound better than the library he paid for.

items.title: CAA's Bryan Lourd Urges Congress to Pass NO FAKES Act to Combat AI Deepfakes
items.excerpt: CAA CEO Bryan Lourd urged Congress to pass the music-industry-backed NO FAKES Act to regulate unauthorised AI voice and likeness deepfakes: 'Every one of us should have the right to say no.'
